description: SWC Mac demo evidence inventory; not a binary-similarity configuration or score report.
reference: Super Wing Commander Mac demo 1.0.2, extracted 68000 CODE resources
address_convention: Byte offsets from the start of each CODE resource, including its segment header; end offsets are exclusive.
validation_strategy: Original instructions, format checks, real-demo integration and shared WC1 runtime tests. SWC binary scoring is not planned without the original Mac toolchain.

functions.differences: Explicit buffer length, index/format checks and host frame descriptor replace a Mac Handle and an A0 pointer return.
The SDL adapter decodes a whole frame; original clipped drawing and hotspot placement are not reconstructed.
Owned SDL buffers replace Mac Handles, purge state and cached pointers. File bytes and output lengths are validated.
Allocation and BE size prefix handling move to the caller; explicit bounds/exact-consumption checks are added; Mac debugger callbacks are absent.
Decode big-endian records into existing WC1 mission structures, validate narrower fields and references, then publish atomically. The original copies Mac records directly.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: Build_objective_list
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: Enyo 1 uses the existing WC1 objective builder; other SWC objective behavior remains unverified.

shared_wc1_evidence.name: nav_getxy
shared_wc1_evidence.qualification: The host currently uses WC1 map coordinates. The SWC original stores world coordinates shifted by eight in wider map fields.
